instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a wide shot from a slightly low angle shows an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. In the center of the room, the man in the black cap (R1) stands on the left facing forward with a neutral expression, wearing a dark polo shirt and blue shorts. Beside him, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt (R2) stands on the right in blue jeans, leaning her shoulder and head slightly toward him with a smile. The room is brightly lit by overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor, with motion capture cameras visible on the background walls.
